scope: Secondary read-only trace analysis, three different frozen cohorts. Never pool them as a controlled iteration effect.
limitations: Native turn usage is aggregate: no per-command/per-request token or billing attribution.
Action items are observed completed command/file-change/MCP items; they are not provider model calls or necessarily separate round trips.
Command read paths and discovery/test classifications are intent proxies, not filesystem I/O traces. Tests and imported dependencies perform other reads.
Command stdout byte counts are not token counts and exclude other model-visible context.
First file_change boundary does not capture mutations through arbitrary commands, though observed benchmarks primarily use native file_change events.
Backend routing, cache residency, realized per-request input and cache-write classification are not fully observed.
All cohorts use small synthetic known-file tasks; none proves general production savings or cross-session memory value.
Protected/external grader test counts can differ when models add extra tests; grader integrity requirements and frozen protected files stay enforced.

recommendations.mechanism: Consolidate legitimate local investigation into one bounded context acquisition, including caller-selected source and caller-selected relevant tests.
recommendations.reason: Focused source rereads are already absent in latest B, while all eight B focus runs still discover files and read tests. Source-only compression cannot remove that work.
recommendations.guardrails: Do not autoexecute repository commands, bypass approval/ignores/secrets, treat tests/AGENTS as higher-priority instructions, or omit source completeness. Benchmark full package with identical A/B grading and all trials.

recommendations.mechanism: Expose an optional minimal trusted workflow hint for unchanged focused files: source is complete, inspect other/newer files as needed, batch independent inspection, and run required tests.
recommendations.reason: The existing notice identifies complete source but remaining command items vary. A small process hint might reduce serial inspection; benefit is unproven.
recommendations.guardrails: Never suppress AGENTS instructions, necessary freshness checks, tests, git checks, or extra investigation. Keep caller task bytes exact.

recommendations.mechanism: Avoid cold full indexing solely to approve an explicit known-file preload; use explicit bounded-source approval only if designed with the same storage/security policy.
recommendations.reason: Cold index and interpreter setup add deterministic local overhead; removing model-visible tool calls still offers much larger possible savings.
recommendations.guardrails: Preserve explicit project approval, current ignore/security eligibility, secure reads, all-source atomicity, and existing APIs; no implicit grant.

recommendations.mechanism: Evaluate native same-thread continuation separately from fresh-session source prefix reuse.
recommendations.reason: Current independent fresh sessions and distinct focus sets cannot establish same-day memory/cache reuse.
recommendations.guardrails: Do not spoof session IDs or cache keys; compare matched related tasks, equivalent history, cache observations and independently graded outcomes.

recommendations.mechanism: Improve benchmarks with multiple repeats, byte-identical controls, fixed success checks and predeclared no-regression gates.
recommendations.reason: Controls have large cache variation, small pair counts and significant outliers. One-repeat win/loss cannot safely drive a task-kind classifier.
recommendations.guardrails: Keep every failure and outlier; no per-task cherry-picking or silent replay. Cost always includes all attempts.
